_readme: AC-APP-1. Every named state the product can be in, and how a test reaches it.
Post-install home: tests/state-matrix.json. Driven by tests/e2e/matrix.spec.ts.
Entry shape:
name     the Appendix A state name, verbatim. The screenshot is state-<name>.png.
goto     the window.__mthGoto row name, or null when the state is a URL rather than
app state. A goto that returns false fails the entry by name: an unreachable
state is a missing surface, never a silently wrong screenshot.
url      navigated instead of /app, for the states that are routes.
screen   expected data-screen, visible.
sheet    expected data-sheet, visible.
visible  a CSS selector that must be visible, for states that share a data-screen with
their siblings (every autopsy panel is data-screen=autopsy).
gate5    the driver skips it. research.* and desktop.* land with the Gate 5 surface.
note     what the state is, and what has to exist for it to be reachable.
Deliberately absent: the land.* rows (Gate 4, the landing page, AC-LAND, whose widths are
tests/e2e/landing-responsive.spec.ts). The dark.* rows are present: `dark.` is a prefix on
a row already here, resolved by gotoPatch in app/src/app/state.ts, and AC-APP-15 asks for the
picture of each one.
Selectors reuse what already ships wherever possible: .m-card and .m-card-c are the two
Card slots, [data-el] is the Gate 2 element id, [data-testid=evidence-sheet] is the Gate 2
sheet. New [data-testid] names below are the contract each surface implementer builds to.
